title: MemSpine gap plan from the 15-engine survey
intro: Every capability another engine has that MemSpine lacks, has only partly, or keeps switched off, with the reason it is not there today and what to do about it. Sources: the 15 verified engine records (docs/engine_survey/*.json), the prompt matrix (23 prompt features scored for all 15 engines), the gap register and ADRs. Status classes: missing = not built; partial = some of it exists; built-off = built and tested but off by default or unscreened; by-design = deliberately absent, with the reason. Re-checked against the code on 2026-10-11: 15 'now' descriptions corrected (see the Claude Doc 'MemSpine Gaps and Solutions').

status_legend.built-off: Built, off by default or unscreened

write_now: Append event, project to SQL / LanceDB / Tantivy
Optional: window segmenter -> call 1 (facts / edges / episode sections) in a non-durable async queue
sleep(): consolidate (extractive summary), decay, compress; all LLM stages off unless bound
write_target: Turn arrives; firewall; append; durable receipt (unchanged)
Window segmenter -> durable window queue (cursor promoted on commit)
Call 1 per window: facts + window summary + edges + episode fragment, with the top existing facts shown under integer aliases and a supersedes field
Deposit through the existing doors: firewall, trust cap, conflict ladder, provenance
Call 2 at session close: session summary, stitched episode, guarded profile operations
Call 3 in the background: entity resolution, invalidation, value histories, observations; triggered by volume and idleness
Per-layer counters for calls, tokens, failures, ungrounded items
read_now: Legs: vector, BM25, temporal (+ perspective, speaker vote in arms)
Assembly: MMR, floor, replay windows, dated lines (harness)
read_target: Query shape + rule date window (relative phrases too)
Legs: raw turns, window facts, episodes, graph, temporal window; each derived hit lifted to its parent turns
Family-protected fusion; reranker scores whole neighbour windows
Hard budget with block shares: raw windows >= 60%, notes <= 20%, summary/profile <= 10%, timelines <= 10%
Zero-LLM hot path; agentic tier only on request

gaps.title: Neighbour-aware extraction with explicit supersede
gaps.others: Mem0 shows the top 10 existing facts and last 10 messages; MIRIX shows each typed agent its own rows with ids; MemMachine shows up to 50 profile features; Mnemon shows every thread and state key; Nemori predicts from known facts and keeps only the gap.
gaps.now: The window call sees only its own turns; updates are handled after the fact by the rule conflict ladder. Per-namespace chronological ordering (the S6 prerequisite) is already met.
gaps.why: Deferred to rollout step S6: it needs chronological per-namespace ordering and its value shows on knowledge-update benchmarks (MemoryAgentBench-CR) more than on LoCoMo.
gaps.proposal: Add a 'known' block to call 1: top 10 live facts for the window's subjects by embedding, shown as integer aliases 0-9 (mapped back in code); add a 'supersedes' field per fact that seeds the conflict ladder (state facts only), and a 'transition' wording rule ('changed from A to B'). Optional predict-calibrate mode (Nemori) behind a flag. Prompt rules to add with it (prompt matrix F7-F9): 'Items marked [kN] are already stored; do not restate them. If a line changes one, emit the new item, name the previous value ("changed from A to B"), set kind state, date it to the change and put the alias in replaces.' and 'A re-mention of a known item is not new; a new occurrence of the same kind of event on another date is.' (mem0 transition and entity-known-is-not-fact-known rules; Nemori delta extraction).
gaps.gate: Focus slice no loss; MAB-CR supersession-order rate up; grounding >= 95%.

gaps.title: Window summary section carried on each fact
gaps.others: MemOS returns a 120-200 word window summary in the same extraction call and stores it on every fact; Memori attaches the conversation summary to each recalled fact.
gaps.now: The episode section already asks for a 50-word summary, but _store_episode keeps only title and narrative (windows.py:894); facts and facts_graph modes have no summary. Every fact already carries a window:<id> tag.
gaps.why: Not in the decided design; surfaced by this survey.
gaps.proposal: Add a 'summary' section (<= 60 words, dated, names participants) to call 1; store it once per window with the cited turns as parents; facts reference it so a fact hit can bring its window summary as a note.
gaps.gate: No extra call; ungrounded rate unchanged; notes block stays within its share.

gaps.title: Durable window queue (retry-safe derivation)
gaps.others: memU stages the cursor and promotes it only on commit; MIRIX claims triggers exactly once through a persisted cursor; Honcho keeps errored queue items 30 days. Counter-examples: Nemori and MemOS lose turns when they delete the buffer or raw window after a failed extraction.
gaps.now: Raw turns are always durable; window jobs live in an in-process queue and are abandoned (counted) on stop.
gaps.why: Step 1 shipped the in-memory queue first; durability was listed as a caveat.
gaps.proposal: Persist window membership and state as events (window_opened / window_done / window_failed) so catch_up re-queues unfinished windows; the cursor advances only after the deposit commits.
gaps.gate: Kill-and-restart test: every window processed exactly once.

gaps.title: Integer aliases instead of ids in prompts
gaps.others: Mem0 swaps UUIDs for 0-9; Hindsight uses short aliases and scrubs ids the model never saw.
gaps.now: Turns appear as [n]; an out-of-range citation is dropped silently and counted as facts_uncited, so an invented alias looks like a missing one. No shipped prompt shows a raw record id yet.
gaps.why: Not needed until neighbours are shown (G-W4).
gaps.proposal: Alias map per call for any record shown to a model; reject outputs that cite aliases not shown.
gaps.gate: Unit tests; zero invented ids.

gaps.title: Local transcript compression before call 1
gaps.others: LightMem compresses each message 20-40% with LLMLingua-2 on a local BERT before extraction; the same encoder segments topics.
gaps.now: Window transcript goes to the model as written (mean 186 tokens on LoCoMo).
gaps.why: Windows are already small; compression can drop the detail a fact needs.
gaps.proposal: Opt-in compressor port; screen only if live window prompts prove large on other datasets.
gaps.gate: Grounding rate and focus slice unchanged; tokens down.

gaps.title: Call 2 content: session summary, stitched episode, profile operations
gaps.others: Honcho rolling short/long summaries with degenerate-output guard; Combined incremental summary with periodic full rebuild and word cap; EverMemOS profile add/update/delete/none ops with caps; MemMachine neighbour-aware profile ADD/DELETE with cited consolidation.
gaps.now: Session-close hook exists but call 2 is a stub; consolidate writes an extractive summary at sleep.
gaps.why: Rollout order decided by the user: facts, then summary, then graph, then episodes.
gaps.proposal: Build call 2: one structured call per closed session with sections summary (<= 120 words), episode (stitched from window fragments) and profile_ops (add/update/delete/none against the current card, observation date, stated vs inferred). Periodic full rebuild every N sessions to stop drift.
gaps.gate: G-C9-style screen: no loss outside open-domain; cat-5 guard; summary spot audit.

gaps.title: Capped, typed profile card
gaps.others: Honcho enforces four prefixes, 200 chars per entry, 40 entries in code; EverMemOS caps 60 items / 8 per category; MIRIX core blocks capped at 5,000 chars.
gaps.now: reflect_profile and profile_header_packing exist but are off; relevance gating of the profile header exists; no card schema or caps.
gaps.why: Profile deferred until summaries are read (user rollout order); OP-Bench lesson that profiles leak into unrelated answers.
gaps.proposal: Card schema (identity / attribute / relationship / instruction), code-enforced caps, stated-only by default, relevance-gated injection.
gaps.gate: OP-Bench irrelevance not worse (when reinstated); hand audit precision >= 90%.

gaps.title: Episode narratives as a retrieval unit
gaps.others: EverMemOS episode per cell is the retrieved unit; Nemori dated third-person episodes with merge; MIRIX episodic events.
gaps.now: Episode-fragment section built in call 1 (window mode all), off; when on, fragments already compete as raw text in the main pool; no dedicated episode leg.
gaps.why: Rollout step 4; new leg and lifting needed first.
gaps.proposal: Episode leg lifted to parent turns (H-index) first, then a notes arm (H-note).
gaps.gate: Beats facts-only on the focus slice or adds blind-slice value.

gaps.title: Value histories and observations with consolidation
gaps.others: Mnemon keyed value histories with a conflict flag; Hindsight observations with proof counts, history and staleness; LightMem similarity-gated offline update.
gaps.now: Keyed semantic facts go through the conflict ladder (supersede / contest / backfill) and records already keep history and corroborations; no consolidated observation layer.
gaps.why: Ladder covers keyed state; cross-fact consolidation was never planned.
gaps.proposal: Call 3 stage: group facts by (subject, attribute) and by embedding (>= 0.9) and write one observation per group with its history and proof count; only groups that changed reach the LLM.
gaps.gate: MAB-CR blind; context tokens down with no loss.

gaps.title: Background triggers by volume and idleness
gaps.others: Honcho dreams after 50 new facts, 60 min idle, at most every 8 h; Hindsight consolidates after every retain; EverMemOS OME has event, cron, idle and counter triggers.
gaps.now: sleep() runs only when called; SleepScheduler exists with interval off; run_sleep_cycle is global, so manual and scheduled cycles can overlap (needs one shared lock).
gaps.why: Library-first design and deterministic evals.
gaps.proposal: Opt-in trigger policy: run call 3 when a namespace gains N facts or goes idle, with a minimum interval; one advisory lock per namespace.
gaps.gate: Unit tests; no change to eval runs (off).

gaps.title: Standing answers (mental models)
gaps.others: Hindsight stores answers to standing questions, refreshed after consolidation by edit operations so untouched sections stay byte-identical; read with no retrieval.
gaps.now: Not present.
gaps.why: Product feature; no benchmark in scope measures it.
gaps.proposal: Later: opt-in standing questions per namespace with delta refresh and pruned citations.
gaps.gate: Behavioural tests only.

gaps.title: Reinforcement count as a salience signal
gaps.others: Honcho times_derived as a retrieval leg and richer-text-wins dedup; Memori num_times; Hindsight proof counts.
gaps.now: Semantic merge bumps importance (+0.1) and utility; scoring weights are 0 in base (relevance-first, ADR-030).
gaps.why: Relevance-first scoring by decision.
gaps.proposal: Count repeats as reinforcement on the record; expose a bounded multiplicative boost (as Hindsight: never overrides relevance), off by default.
gaps.gate: Focus slice; OP-Bench repetition subscore when reinstated.

gaps.title: Hard context budget with block shares
gaps.others: Mnemon 16 items / 12,000 chars with index blocks inside the budget (3.8k tokens); Hindsight token-denominated rank-order packing; MemOS floor + MMR + per-type quotas.
gaps.now: Engine budget, MMR and header shares exist; the real defect is an early break in assembly.py:288-299 that stops packing at the first oversize item; no per-block caps for derived layers.
gaps.why: Derived layers were not in the read path yet.
gaps.proposal: Block budgets (raw >= 60%, notes <= 20%, summary/profile <= 10%, timelines <= 10%), rank-order packing so one long item cannot evict shorter ones.
gaps.gate: Tokens per question down or flat; no net loss.

gaps.title: Rerank whole neighbour windows
gaps.others: MemMachine expands each hit with neighbours (1/3 back, 2/3 forward) and reranks the window as one string; time-aware rerank input.
gaps.now: rerank_context exists (reranker can score a turn with its neighbours); replay windows are still added after reranking.
gaps.why: Not tried.
gaps.proposal: Arm: rerank document = hit plus its window (dated), then fill best-first under the budget.
gaps.gate: Focus slice (multi-hop, temporal).

gaps.title: Temporal window from relative phrases
gaps.others: Hindsight dateparser window with 8-bucket coverage; MIRIX rule-parsed phrase; Cognee timestamp-tightness rerank.
gaps.now: Temporal leg fires on absolute dates; relative spans exist (temporal_relative, opt-in) but resolve against the read clock, not the question's anchor date.
gaps.why: Earlier screen (B4) showed no gain on LoCoMo questions.
gaps.proposal: Window leg ranked by similarity inside the window with bucket coverage; useful on datasets with 'last week' style questions.
gaps.gate: Blind sets; LoCoMo temporal no loss.

gaps.title: Entity boost with an anti-hub penalty
gaps.others: Mem0 boost = sim x 0.5 x 1/(1 + 0.001(n-1)^2), capped and max over entities.
gaps.now: entity_leg built, off; entity_expand_leg is already damped; no hub penalty on the entity leg itself.
gaps.why: Entity layer unscreened.
gaps.proposal: Add the penalty to entity_leg and screen with G-C3.
gaps.gate: Focus slice.

gaps.title: Evidence lifting and one score across layers
gaps.others: EverMemOS heap-expand lets facts and episodes compete under one calibrated score; Memori facts find, summaries fill.
gaps.now: Source-family pool built (R02); view_tags leg carries facts; lifting derived hits to parent turns exists via facts_to_sources.
gaps.why: Derived layers not yet in the read path.
gaps.proposal: Lift each derived hit to its parent turns; family-protected fusion; derived text only as capped notes.
gaps.gate: Focus slice; tokens within +30%.

gaps.title: Two read tiers with a caller-chosen level
gaps.others: Honcho get_context (zero LLM) versus dialectic with five reasoning levels.
gaps.now: Zero-LLM read is the default; agentic, slot, fact chain and ledger are config switches, not a per-call level.
gaps.why: Agentic tier screened negative on LoCoMo (f-slot net -3 at 8x cost).
gaps.proposal: Per-call 'depth' argument mapping to existing enhancers with budgets; default stays zero-LLM.
gaps.gate: API tests.

gaps.title: Prompt-cache-friendly calls
gaps.others: Hindsight bank-agnostic cached system prefix with provider breakpoints; Mnemon republishes an unchanged View to keep the cache warm.
gaps.now: Stable prefix placed first in assembly; window prompt has a static system part.
gaps.why: Local Ollama; caching gains small (prefill is ~10% of call time).
gaps.proposal: Keep all variable content last in every prompt; add cache hints when a hosted provider is bound.
gaps.gate: None (cost only).

gaps.title: Per-layer cost ledger
gaps.others: LightMem per-stage calls and tokens; Nemori per-phase accounting with a hard token budget; Honcho per-call token telemetry.
gaps.now: window_stats (about 40 counters) for call 1 and model_usage per role; sleep layers lack failure and grounding counters.
gaps.why: Built for step 1 only.
gaps.proposal: Same counters for every derived layer, plus an optional write token budget that stops extraction when spent.
gaps.gate: Tests.

gaps.title: Incremental re-ingest of edited documents
gaps.others: Cognee diffs a document against stored chunks and re-extracts only changed regions, verifying the reassembly; Hindsight delta retain.
gaps.now: Resource ingest is idempotent per (path, fingerprint) but re-ingests a changed document whole.
gaps.why: Resource memory is not in the benchmark scope.
gaps.proposal: Chunk-level diff with parent reuse; later.
gaps.gate: Unit tests.

gaps.title: Implicit feedback from conversation
gaps.others: Cognee rates the previous answer and served context each turn and moves weights by EMA.
gaps.now: Explicit feedback verb (like / dislike / note) only.
gaps.why: Extra LLM call per turn; risk of self-reinforcement.
gaps.proposal: Not now; revisit with a local classifier (decision port) instead of an LLM.

gaps.title: Per-observer views (theory of mind)
gaps.others: Honcho keeps one collection per (observer, observed) pair and fans one extraction out to all observers.
gaps.now: Perspective tags (speaker, addressee, subject, asker) on every turn; one store per namespace.
gaps.why: Single-user assistant focus; tags cover the read side.
gaps.proposal: Derived 'about X as seen by Y' view built from perspective tags at sleep, multi-agent template only.
gaps.gate: Multi-agent tests.

gaps.title: LLM decider on every read
gaps.others: EverMemOS llm_multiround (1-3 decider calls reading 50+ episodes); Mnemon hosted judge reading ~35k tokens per question.
gaps.now: Agentic, slot, fact chain and ledger built and off.
gaps.why: Local 9B reader, cost per question, and our f-slot screen (net -3 at 8x time).
gaps.proposal: Keep opt-in; revisit only with a cheap local judge (OpenDecider) as screener, never as a gate.

gaps.title: Model-written skills and lessons
gaps.others: MIRIX budgeted skill evolution; MemOS skill crystallisation; memU skill files written by the host agent.
gaps.now: Procedural memory with fixed-template lessons (ADR-060).
gaps.why: A model-written lesson is an injection and drift vector.
gaps.proposal: Slot-filling procedure cases rendered by template, advisory stage only (design B5.9), when agent trajectories are in scope.
gaps.gate: Behavioural tests.

gaps.title: Human-editable Markdown as the source of truth
gaps.others: EverMemOS and memU keep memory as Markdown files with a rebuildable index.
gaps.now: Append-only event log with rebuildable projections.
gaps.why: The log gives audit, erasure cascades and replay that files do not.
gaps.proposal: Optional Markdown export view, not a source of truth.

gaps.title: Overwrite or delete on update
gaps.others: MIRIX, Honcho, LightMem and MemMachine overwrite or delete old values.
gaps.now: Supersede / contest with history and as-of reads.
gaps.why: History and auditability; validity intervals.
gaps.proposal: Keep.

gaps.title: Hosted or closed extraction
gaps.others: Memori sends every exchange to a closed hosted extractor.
gaps.now: Local model roles only.
gaps.why: User decision: local reader and extractor; privacy.
gaps.proposal: Keep.

gaps.title: Foresight predictions
gaps.others: EverMemOS writes up to 10 predictions per cell (now disabled by default because nothing reads them).
gaps.now: Prospective watches from stated plans (auto_watch).
gaps.why: Speculation stored as memory conflicts with 'never store an inference as a fact'.
gaps.proposal: Keep plans from stated text only.

gaps.title: KV-cache (activation) memory
gaps.others: MemOS prefills WorkingMemory into a HuggingFace or vLLM KV cache and reuses it.
gaps.now: Not present.
gaps.why: Reader runs in Ollama; KV reuse needs an in-process model.
gaps.proposal: Revisit with the llama.cpp in-process adapter.

gaps.title: Multimodal ingest
gaps.others: Hindsight inline attachments; EverMemOS parser; MemOS vision extraction.
gaps.now: E04 asset pre-compute built; the vision model is installed but not to be used.
gaps.why: User decision: do not use the vision model yet.
gaps.proposal: Hold until the user enables it.

gaps.title: Same-language rule in every write prompt
gaps.others: Hindsight (same language and script, never translate), Mem0 (input-language block), EverMemOS (language module at head and tail), MemOS.
gaps.now: No write prompt has a language rule; window_extract includes only no_injection.j2, and the gold-lint globs only defaults/*.yaml, so partials are never screened.
gaps.why: Benchmarks in scope are English.
gaps.proposal: Shared partial same_language.j2: write each item in the language of its lines, never translate names, titles or quoted words; keys and enum values stay English. Include in window_extract, extract@session*, extract_edges*, summarize*, summarize_entity.
gaps.gate: Unit test renders; English output unchanged on the focus slice.

gaps.title: Mode and source fields on each fact (denials, who asserted it)
gaps.others: EverMemOS speech-act gate; MemOS grounding validator marks assistant-only and user-denied content; Honcho assent-transfer rule; Cognee rejects assistant-only claims.
gaps.now: Rule 7 marks plans and wishes in prose only; no negation field and no 'proposed vs confirmed' field, although records already carry provenance classes src(m) (prompt matrix F5).
gaps.why: Window prompt v1 kept the schema small for a 9B model.
gaps.proposal: Add mode (stated | plan | wish | hypothetical | opinion | negated) and source (user_stated | assistant_proposed | user_confirmed) to facts; map source onto src(m) and cap trust for assistant_proposed; keep denials as negated items that the reader must not cite as positives.
gaps.gate: Focus slice no loss; OP-Bench sycophancy subscores when reinstated.

gaps.title: Length bound per fact
gaps.others: Mem0 15-80 words; Hindsight 1-2 sentences; Mnemon events at most 30 words.
gaps.now: Episode fields are bounded; a fact's value is not (prompt matrix F10).
gaps.why: Not specified in v1.
gaps.proposal: 'value is one sentence of at most 40 words; split longer statements', with a soft cap (warn, not drop) in the validator; keep the self-contained rule above the length rule.
gaps.gate: Grounding rate unchanged; mean fact length down.

gaps.title: Diagnostic repair re-ask for a failed section
gaps.others: Hindsight re-asks with the keys used versus the valid keys; MIRIX tool-error guidance.
gaps.now: Code-side JSON repair and per-section validation; a schema-invalid section is dropped (prompt matrix F16).
gaps.why: Fail-closed chosen first; split mode handles repeated failures.
gaps.proposal: One repair retry for the failed sections only, carrying the validator errors; forbid new items and diff against the failed output.
gaps.gate: sections_dropped down; no new ungrounded items.

gaps.title: Gold-lint screens single-word tokens
gaps.others: Mnemon uses no few-shot examples at all; EverMemOS, Nemori and LightMem examples carry benchmark material.
gaps.now: CI gold-lint catches known multi-word answers and speaker names in *.yaml only; single-word tokens and _partials/*.j2 are not screened.
gaps.why: Lint written after I80 for the observed leak shapes.
gaps.proposal: Screen every capitalised token and quoted word in prompts against benchmark answer and speaker vocabularies, with an allow-list for invented names.
gaps.gate: Lint passes on the current prompts.

gaps.title: Coarse dates as full spans
gaps.others: Hindsight turns year-only or month-only dates into the full period range, never day one.
gaps.now: Window facts accept YYYY-MM or YYYY, parsed as day one of the period (pipelines.py:2924); no happened/said is passed, though the temporal leg already matches happened: spans by overlap.
gaps.why: Not specified.
gaps.proposal: Prompt rule plus code: a coarse date becomes a [start, end] span on the record; temporal leg matches by overlap.
gaps.gate: Unit tests; temporal no loss.

gaps.title: Importance label at write time
gaps.others: Memori importance and promotion flags; Mnemon runtime writes with importance.
gaps.now: Confidence 0-1 only; w_imp is 0 by design (relevance-first).
gaps.why: Relevance-first scoring decision (ADR-030).
gaps.proposal: Optional importance (low | normal | high) feeding w_imp behind a flag only.
gaps.gate: Off by default.

gaps.title: Online graph call: one short item list per batch of turns
gaps.others: Graphiti: 2 calls per episode plus one dedupe call per new fact, resolution by exact name, entropy gate and MinHash before any LLM; Hindsight and Cognee take entities and relations from the same call; Honcho, Mnemon and LightMem use one static, example-free call per token-gated batch with cited lines.
gaps.now: Steps 1-5 make no model call. W1 (off) emits facts and edges separately (958-token prompt in facts_graph; every relation written twice; speaker/subject/confidence never read); edges wait in an in-memory buffer for the extract_graph sleep stage; the entity resolver runs only at sleep.
gaps.why: An inline call costs about 50x the hot path (2.7 s per 9B call vs 55-210 ms), so the call runs right after the write; LLM merges and contradiction checks stay at sleep (ADR-066 call 3).
gaps.proposal: window_extract: graph mode. One item list {s, r, o, text, kind, when, lines, span}; 309-token example-free prompt with a KNOWN names line; every item span-grounded; names resolved in code (rules mode, no LLM); deposit through emit factored out of extract_graph (state supersedes, event adds); window_max_turns 1 gives per-turn.
gaps.gate: Prompt ~300 tokens, output tokens per window down >=30%, p50 call latency down, turn-to-edge under 10 s at max_turns 1; focus slice vs f-jref-i2, full set within noise, MAB-CR and ConvoMem not down; gold-lint clean.

gaps.title: Graph key identity (kind, occurrence, archived states)
gaps.others: Graphiti keeps each edge occurrence with its own uuid and episode list; duplicates are judged per fact with numeric and date qualifiers.
gaps.now: _edge_key (workers/pipelines.py:1882) keys (ns, src, rel, dst) without kind; undated event keys carry no occurrence; dated keys collapse same-day repeats; an archived state key short-circuits before the conflict ladder (A then B then A is skipped).
gaps.why: Found by the Codex review of G-W49 and verified in code; an online graph deposit would make these collisions frequent.
gaps.proposal: Key = (ns, src, rel, dst, kind) plus an occurrence id for events (cited turn ids, not only the day); an archived or superseded key goes to the conflict ladder instead of being skipped. Prerequisite for G-W49.
gaps.gate: Unit tests: A-B-A state returns to A; two same-day events stay two; reruns stay idempotent.

gaps.title: Evaluation gate hardening
gaps.others: Codex review: eval_focus verdict uses slice labels with --ref informational; eval_blind compares intersecting questions and can confirm with a dataset missing; 0.328*sqrt(n) is not per dataset.
gaps.now: Gates per evals/eval_focus.py and evals/eval_blind.py; gold-lint catches literal overlap only.
gaps.why: Without paired, complete comparisons a prompt change can be adopted on noise or on one dataset.
gaps.proposal: Pinned run manifests; truly paired comparisons against the named reference; per-conversation bootstrap uncertainty per dataset; all blind sets required; repeated dev runs; one frozen blind run per adoption; keep per-slice non-inferiority and OP-Bench checks (GAP_TO_SOLUTION_PLAN.md:211).
gaps.gate: A known-null change (seed swap) is never adopted; a run missing a blind set cannot confirm.

leads: Write-time firewall with corroboration release (no other engine has one in open source).
Lineage on every derived record with trust = minimum of parents, and erasure that cascades into derived records, caches and window replies.
Event-sourced store: every index rebuildable; tamper-evident audit and taint repair.
Deterministic conflict ladder with named rungs; supersede and contest keep history.
Store-learned thresholds (topic boundary, relevance gate) instead of tuned constants.
Measurement discipline: errata, paired flips, noise bands, forensics, gold-text lint, official F1 port, blind sets.

waves.name: Small, CPU only, no screen needed
Read and extraction changes, focus-slice screens
waves.time: about 1 day build + screens after f-win
